reviewException.reviewBy: 2026-10-10 or before adding another maintainer, whichever is earlier
reviewException.expiryAction: Owner reviews exception; no automatic switch to one approval that would lock out a sole maintainer.

requiredDeploymentCheck.name: KnightBite release verification
requiredDeploymentCheck.match: Deployment git commit SHA must equal the successful push check head SHA. GitHub app binding is enforced in GitHub protection; Vercel UI offers named GitHub checks, not a separately verified app-ID control.

doNotEnableInThisPass: Require Verified Commits (unsigned local history; separate signing decision)

temporaryHoldIfRequired.effect: Keeps current production alias; subsequent production builds are not auto-promoted. GitHub Deployment Checks require auto-assignment ON, so this is a manual hold, not proof of an active deployment-check gate.
temporaryHoldIfRequired.reactivation: Separate approval; inspect all pending deployments, select approved final SHA, verify its successful check before restoring ON.
